negative_reviews.author: nova
negative_reviews.text: I recently went here with one of my friends and we are both young adults being 18. The server didn’t check up on us and seemed annoyed when we tried to use the £5 voucher. It felt like a hassle trying to get their attention to order more food. When we asked for the bill it took awhile for them to give it to us. Normally this wouldn’t be an issue because if you’re busy you’re busy like i get it but, they were attending to people who came in after is and we’re older. I don’t want to make assumptions but it may be because “teenagers don’t tip”. Even though there a service charge and we was gonna tip before the bad service. The food was decent.
